newsitem.title: UK: UK gov't says minimum wage could cost million jobs.
newsitem.headline: UK gov't says minimum wage could cost million jobs.

text.p: A minimum wage, if it was imposed at 4.26 stg ($6.78) per hour, could lead to the loss of more than one million jobs in Britain, junior trade minister John Taylor said on Monday.

"In December 1995, my officials estimated that a minimum wage set at 4.26 stg, as advocated by last year's Trades Union Congress, would lead to the loss of over one million jobs, with only half restoration of wage differentials," Taylor said in a written response to a parliamentary question.
The Trades Union Congress voted for a national minimum wage of 4.26 pounds an hour at its annual conference last September.
